en.name: Corsair RM750e Power Supply 750W
en.description:
## Corsair RM750e 750W

A fully-modular 80 PLUS Gold-certified power supply with a near-silent 0 dB fan mode at low loads.

- 750W continuous output
- 80 PLUS Gold efficiency
- Fully modular cables, 10-year warranty
